questions.text: Under the checked PD 1096 text, what first separates Group F cold storage from Group G warehouse storage?

options.text: The hazard and combustibility of the stored material.
The number of loading dock doors only.
Whether the building has an office mezzanine.
The brand of refrigeration equipment.

questions.rationale: PD 1096 places cold storage and incombustible non-explosive storage in Group F, while hazardous, flammable, and highly combustible warehouse storage falls under Group G.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Section 3.3 Group G Occupancies; ERR-DSGN-003

questions.text: Which use is explicitly included in RA 9514 storage occupancy?

options.text: Warehouses and cold storages.
Classrooms used for instruction.
Hospitals with 24-hour patient beds.
Restaurants with fifty or more occupants.

questions.rationale: The checked RA 9514 storage definition includes warehouses and cold storages.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Group G Occupant Load Standards; Fire Egress Requirements

questions.text: What does RA 9514 high-piled storage depend on in the checked definition?

options.text: Combustible pile height and the floor area used for that storage.
The number of forklifts assigned to the building.
The refrigeration temperature only.
The loading dock height only.

questions.rationale: RA 9514 defines high-piled storage by combustible material pile height and by whether the area used exceeds the stated floor-area threshold.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Parking Standards for Group G Occupancies

questions.text: What is the default number-of-exits rule for a storage building under the checked RA 9514 text?

options.text: At least two separate means of egress remote from each other.
Exactly one exit for every storage building.
No exits if the building is automated.
Only one sliding door at the loading bay.

questions.rationale: RA 9514 states that every storage building or separately considered section shall have at least two separate means of egress, subject to a narrow exception.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Group G Warehouse Standards; Occupancy Load and Parking Requirements

questions.text: When does the checked RA 9514 storage exception allow at least one means of egress?

options.text: For rooms or spaces under 1,394 sqm gross area where fewer than ten persons may normally be present.
For any warehouse with sprinklers regardless of size.
For high-hazard storage rooms above 1,394 sqm.
For all cold storages because they are refrigerated.

questions.rationale: The checked exception applies to rooms or spaces below 1,394 sqm gross area where fewer than ten persons may normally be present.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Group G Occupant Load Standards

questions.text: For high-hazard storage commodities, what travel-distance limit is source-safe under RA 9514?

options.text: An exit within 23 m, increased to 30 m where automatic fire suppression protection is provided.
An exit within 100 m without conditions.
No travel-distance limit if goods are on pallets.
Only the parking travel distance matters.

questions.rationale: RA 9514 limits high-hazard storage exit access to 23 m, with an increase to 30 m where automatic fire suppression protection is provided.
questions.code_citation: NBCP Warehouse Design Standards; Loading Dock Specifications

questions.text: Which statement about storage egress signs and lighting is supported by RA 9514?

options.text: Means of egress must have compliant signs, proper illumination, and emergency lighting for normally occupied areas and egress components.
Signs are required only at loading docks.
Lighting is waived for cold storage.
Only exterior yard lighting is covered.

questions.rationale: The checked RA 9514 storage provisions require signs, illumination, and emergency lighting for normally occupied areas and means-of-egress components.
questions.code_citation: ASHRAE Cold Storage Design Standards; Warehouse Design Guidelines

questions.text: Which alarm statement is source-safe for storage occupancies?

options.text: Approved automatic fire detection and alarm is required for all storage occupancies except ordinary or low hazard buildings not exceeding 2,000 sqm, which need manual fire alarm.
No storage building needs alarm systems.
Only high-piled storage needs any alarm device.
Alarms are required only for restaurants.

questions.rationale: RA 9514 requires automatic detection and alarm for storage occupancies, except ordinary or low hazard buildings not exceeding 2,000 sqm where manual fire alarm is required.

questions.text: What does the checked RA 9514 text require for every high-hazard occupancy?

options.text: Automatic fire suppression system protection appropriate to the hazard.
Only portable ladders.
No suppression if there are two exits.
Only a written warehouse operations manual.

questions.rationale: The checked RA 9514 storage protection text requires every high-hazard occupancy to have automatic fire suppression system protection appropriate to the hazard.
questions.code_citation: ASHRAE Cold Storage Design Standards; Building Science Insulation Guidelines

questions.text: What parking/loading cue is supported by the checked PD 1096 Group G row?

options.text: Industrial buildings, warehouses, and storage bins use the checked G-1 parking and loading row.
All warehouses use the hotel room parking row.
Warehouse parking is based on dining customer area.
No truck maneuvering area is ever considered.

questions.rationale: PD 1096 lists industrial buildings, warehouses, and storage bins under the checked Group G-1 parking and loading row.
